violations.text: The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was lacking proper signage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/01/2026
The hand-washing sink in the toilet room was lacking paper towels. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/01/2026

Beverages such as mango drink and lemonade placed in to-go cups in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. Beverages were removed from the self-service refrigerator and placed behind the counter. New Violation. Correct By: 06/01/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the following have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: shelves in the walk in cooler deli display case including door tracks. The deli display case also has an accumulation of ice and frozen drips in and on the interior drip tray. The ice cream chest freezer has an accumulation of frost and debris. Fan attached to the wall in front of the food line has an accumulation of dust. New Violation. Correct By: 06/01/2026
The grease trap is lacking a lid over the chain mechanism, exposing all the waste inside. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/05/2026
A ceiling tile in the kitchen is missing, exposing unwrapped spun insulation and wiring. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026
The floors in the kitchen and walk in cooler are in poor repair, cracked, with holes. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/01/2027

The floors especially around and beneath equipment have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 06/01/2026

The outside area along the building has an accumulation of cut branches and vegetation. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026
The ceiling in the kitchen area is in poor repair. Observed tiles to be peeling. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 12/28/2023
The Person in charge did not assure compliance with critical code requirements. New Violation. Correct By: 12/28/2023
Strainer was observed in the hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 12/28/2023

Pollo, pork, beans and chicken, which was prepared in advance, was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 12/28/2023

Ambient of prep unit was at 49 degrees, ambient of refrigerator was at 47 degrees and ambient of meat walk in was at 44. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 12/28/2023

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Per interview of cook, various foods were placed hot in the refrigerator in containers greater than four inches deep. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 12/28/2023
Prep unit, 2 door refrigerator and meat walk in located in the kitchen area was not in good repair. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 12/28/2023
The ceiling in the kitchen area is in poor repair. Observed tiles to be peeling. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 12/28/2023
A strainer was observed in the hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. New Violation. Correct By: 12/12/2023

Tripe and chicharron, which was prepared in advance, was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours. Disposed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 12/12/2023

Ambient of the kitchen reach-in was observed at 52 degrees, milk cooler at 45 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. New Violation. Correct By: 12/12/2023

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Chicharron and mondongo were observed at 47 and 49 degrees F in the walk-in cooler. Per interview of (cook), chicharron and tripe were placed hot in the refrigerator in plastic containers greater than four inches deep. Proper cooling methods reviewed. New Violation. Correct By: 12/12/2023

Working containers of dry ingredients located in the dry storage area are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. New Violation. Correct By: 12/12/2023

The presence of rodents is not controlled as evidenced by rodent droppings observed on a cutting board in storage. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 12/12/2023
The 2 door unit and lo boy located in the kitchen were not in good repair. Units taken out of service and foods relocated during inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 12/12/2023
The ceiling in the kitchen area is in poor repair. Theiling tiles were observed peeling. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 12/12/2023
